Bill.BriefDescription: Providing tax incentives for employer provided health care.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to tax incentives for employer provided healthcare; adding a new section to chapter 82.04 RCW; and providing aneffective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In computing tax there may be deducted from the measure of taxthe amount paid by small employers to provide health care services forits employees. Payments made by employees are not eligible fordeduction under this subsection. (2) For the purposes of this section, the following definitionsapply: (a) "Small employer" has the meaning provided in RCW 48.43.005; (b) "Health care services" means a health benefit plan as definedin RCW 48.43.005, contributions to health savings accounts as definedby the United States internal revenue service, or other health careservices purchased by the small employer for its employees.
